Its theme, NUEVA ERA, opens a new chapter.  T H E M E  NUEVA ERA  A New Era  “Nueva Era” is Spanish for “New Era”. It speaks to a generation standing at a turning point.  K nowl edge .   Ne w  Ge n e r a t i on .   Ti m e .  T r a ns f orm a t i on .   P ro g r e ss .  T H E   F E S T I V A L  DALENZIA is the annual festival of Dalailussunna Dars, Ayiroor, Perumpadappu, Malappuram. DALENZIA 2K26, the second edition, takes place on   December 21 and 22, 2026   in Ayiroor.  T H E   I D E A  NUEVA ERA joins heritage with the digital age. A lamp, books and mandala stand for what the Dars tradition has always valued. Pixels, a play button and a world map show where the next generation is heading. The identity keeps both sides in one clear visual language.  T H I S   G U I D E L I N E   B O O K  This book explains the logo, colours, typography and every supplied design element: its meaning, its link to NUEVA ERA and how to use it in future festival designs. N E W   G E N E R A T I O N  A young generation with dreams, ready to take off.  T I M E  Every moment is a chance to begin again. D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   C O R E   G R A P H I C   E L E M E N T S V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   0 7 / 1 6  0 6   —   C O R E   G R A P H I C   E L E M E N T S  Core Elements I   The three symbols that come straight from the logo.  01   Hourglass   L O G O   E L E M E N T C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  The lead symbol of the identity. Sand runs from one chamber to the other while a new chapter begins.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Time, transformation and a new beginning.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It opens the NUEVA ERA logo, so the theme is read first as time and change.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Corner mark, section marker or watermark. Keep the line weight and proportions of the logo version.  02   Play Button   L O G O   E L E M E N T C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A triangle inside a ring, the universal sign for pressing play. It turns an idea into action.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Action, progress and moving forward.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It closes the logo on the right and shows that the new era is already in motion.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Video, registration and call-to-action areas. Always point right. Never rotate or mirror.  03   Pixel Squares   L O G O   E L E M E N T C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  Small squares that scatter from the logo like digital data. A modern language beside traditional imagery.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Digital innovation and the connection between tradition and technology.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  They sit at the top right of the logo and return in the poster banner, linking mark and artwork.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Small clusters of three to six squares in corners or beside headings. Never fill a whole background.

D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   C O R E   G R A P H I C   E L E M E N T S V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   0 8 / 1 6  0 7   —   C O R E   G R A P H I C   E L E M E N T S  Core Elements II   Geometry, lines and rhythm that structure every layout.  04   Circular Geometry   P A T T E R N C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  Concentric rings surround the play symbol and fill the digital circle inside the poster arch.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Continuity, movement and an evolving identity.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  The logo rings and the arch circle repeat one idea: the new era keeps turning.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Thin outlines or soft backing circles behind logos and key visuals. Crop at page edges. Gold or crimson only.  05   Thin Lines   L I N E   S Y S T E M C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  Fine rules and frames that organise a layout. The poster uses gold frame lines and slim dividers.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Structure, alignment and visual balance.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  They give lively elements a calm framework, like the margins of a manuscript.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Gold lines of 0.25 to 0.5 mm as dividers, frames and caption rules. Align to page margins. Never heavy.  13   Wave Lines   D E C O R A T I V E C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  Three parallel lines in a repeating curve, drawn in deep crimson.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Rhythm, movement and continuity.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  They run along the foot of the poster as a border and carry the eye across the layout.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Footer or divider band at full width. One band per page. Crimson only. Do not stretch vertically.

D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   T R A D I T I O N A L   &   C U L T U R A L   E L E M E N T S V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   0 9 / 1 6  0 8   —   T R A D I T I O N A L   &   C U L T U R A L   E L E M E N T S  Heritage Elements   Knowledge, culture and the value of time.  07   Traditional Lamp with Books   T R A D I T I O N A L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A lit oil lamp resting on stacked books. A classic picture of the study room.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Knowledge, education, heritage and enlightenment.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It stands at the base of the arch: learning lights the way into the new era and honours the Dars tradition.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Lead image for education, talks and heritage topics. Rest it on a base shape. Keep original colours.  11   Mandala   C U L T U R A L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A circular pattern of loops, petals and bead rings in deep crimson on cream.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Cultural identity, tradition and artistic heritage.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It sits behind the lower right of the poster: a circle of tradition behind the forward motion.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Large backing pattern in a lower corner, partly covered by other elements. Do not recolour.  09   Golden Hourglass   T R A D I T I O N A L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A polished golden hourglass with falling sand. The rich form of the theme's time symbol.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  The value of time and transformation.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It echoes the flat hourglass in the logo and balances the arch on the right side of the poster.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Feature illustration on one side of a layout. Do not show it beside the logo hourglass at the same size.

D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   D I G I T A L   &   M O D E R N   E L E M E N T S V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   1 0 / 1 6  0 9   —   D I G I T A L   &   M O D E R N   E L E M E N T S  Digital Elements   The gateway, the globe and the journey ahead.  06   Arch / Portal   D I G I T A L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A tall rounded arch with a digital circle at its heart, framing the scene like a doorway.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  The entrance into a new era.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It stands left of the title banner: tradition passes through a gateway into the digital age.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Main frame for hero visuals, stage backdrops and entry gates. Keep proportions. Place at the left.  12   Pixel World Map   D I G I T A L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A world map built from rounded squares in white and gold, with cyan accents.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Global connection and wider perspectives.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It lies on the crimson base of the arch under the paper plane: local roots with global reach.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Place on deep crimson surfaces at the base of key visuals. Ask for a transparent PNG for layered use.  08   Paper Plane   D I G I T A L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A folded paper plane with handwritten lines and a dotted loop behind it.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Dreams, communication and new journeys.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It takes off from the books toward the world map: the leap from learning to reach.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Invitations, messages, registration and journey themes. Place on an upward diagonal. Keep the dotted trail.

D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   D E C O R A T I V E   E L E M E N T S   &   P A T T E R N S V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   1 1 / 1 6  1 0   —   D E C O R A T I V E   E L E M E N T S   &   P A T T E R N S  Decorative & Panels   Growth, framing and ready-made information panels.  10   Botanical Elements   D E C O R A T I V E C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A cream vine with leaves wound around a crimson leaf branch.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  Growth, development and creativity.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It rises beside the title banner: a new generation growing out of heritage.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Soften edges of banners and frames. Rise upward from a corner. Overlap edges, never text.  14   Festival Title Banner   P A N E L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  A vertical crimson panel with gold frame, the DALENZIA FEST title, the date, venue and a pixel cluster.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  The festival's name and details gathered into one strong column.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It is the central spine of the poster that the other elements gather around.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Main information column at centre or centre-right. Use as supplied. Do not edit its text.  15   Blank Banner Panel   P A N E L C O N C E P T   &   M E A N I N G  The same crimson panel with gold frame and fine dot texture, left empty for new content.  S Y M B O L I C   R E P R E S E N T A T I O N  A frame ready for any announcement within the NUEVA ERA identity.  C O N N E C T I O N   W I T H   N U E V A   E R A  It carries the look of the poster banner into new formats.  R E C O M M E N D E D   U S A G E  Add date, venue or titles in Poppins, in white and gold only. Keep a clear margin inside the frame.

D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   M A I N   P O S T E R   –   V I S U A L   B R E A K D O W N V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   1 2 / 1 6  1 1   —   M A I N   P O S T E R  Poster Breakdown  The official DALENZIA 2K26 poster, shown unaltered, with each visual element numbered at its position.  1 3 4 5 9 10 6 2 7 8  1   NUEVA ERA logo  Top left on the cream field, with clear space on every side.  2   Vertical DALENZIA title  The central column holding festival name, date and venue.  3   Arch-shaped digital visual  A gateway around the digital circle: the entrance to the new era.  4   Lamp and books  Knowledge at the base of the arch.  5   Paper plane  Takes off from the books toward the world map.  6   Botanical decoration  A vine rising beside the title for growth.  7   Hourglass  Golden time symbol that balances the arch.  8   Mandala  Heritage pattern behind the lower right.  9   Pixel world map  Global reach on the crimson base of the arch.  10   Decorative wave lines  A rhythmic border along the foot of the page.  T R A D I T I O N  The lamp, books, mandala, botanical vine and golden hourglass carry heritage and craft. Their warm, hand-finished look comes from the Dars tradition of study.  D I G I T A L  The pixel map, the digital circle in the arch, the plane and the pixel squares bring in the modern world. All of it sits on one crimson and gold palette.

D A L E N Z I A   2 K 2 6   ·   N U E V A   E R A   E L E M E N T   C O M B I N A T I O N   &   C O M P O S I T I O N V I S U A L B R A N D I D E N T I T Y & D E S I G N E L E M E N T G U I D E L I N E B O O K   1 3 / 1 6  1 2   —   E L E M E N T   C O M B I N A T I O N   &   C O M P O S I T I O N  Building a Layout   A three-step method for combining the supplied elements in future posters.  S T E P   1   ·   B A S E  Cream page, logo top left, the information panel and the wave border.  S T E P   2   ·   A N C H O R S  Add the arch on the left and the hourglass on the right to balance the panel.  S T E P   3   ·   A C C E N T S  Layer the mandala behind, then lamp, plane and vine in front.  L A Y E R I N G   O R D E R  B A C K  Mandala, soft shapes, patterns  M I D D L E  Arch, title banner, panels  F R O N T  Lamp, plane, hourglass, vine  C O M P O S I T I O N   R U L E S  1   One hero.  Choose one dominant element or column. Everything else supports it.  2   Balance left and right.  Put the arch on one side and the hourglass or vine on the other.  3   Layer in three levels.  Patterns at the back, frames in the middle, objects in front.  4   Group by meaning.  Keep lamp, books and plane together as one story, with the map below.  5   Leave room for text.  Keep type on panels or clear cream areas, never on busy artwork.  6   Limit the cast.  Use five to seven elements per layout. More becomes noise.
